### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (2)
- `GET /twCRZdZHv/Gn7yN/NBZA/{NBZAToken}/bBJnKQVZfQ/AwhXQQM/hDSkB` — Authenticate using a token.
- `POST /$rpc/{$rpcToken}/GenerateIT` — Generate an IT token (authentication).

### Data Read (10)
- `GET /action/0` — Read action data.
- `GET /ct` — Read CT data.
- `GET /forms/pricing/` — Read pricing information for forms.
- `GET /integrations/filter-apps/` — Read available integrations.
- `GET /metrics/{metricId}` — Read a specific metric by ID.
- `GET /metrics/as/d/ccm/conversion/{conversionId}/` — Read conversion metrics by ID.
- `GET /p/insights/s/0.8.54` — Read insights data (version info).
- `GET /p/insights/t/{tId}` — Read campaign insights by ID.
- `GET /pagead/conversion/{conversionId}/` — Read conversion data by ID.
- `GET /v3/appfabric-integration/lib/dotcom-appfabric-webapp` — Read appfabric integration data.

### Data Write (7)
- `POST /actionp/0` — Post action data.
- `POST /forms/gauid/` — Submit form data.
- `POST /metrics/d/ccm/form-data/{form-dataId}` — Submit form data to Mailchimp via CCM.
- `POST /mon` — Post monitoring data.
- `POST /p/insights/c/v` — Post campaign insights data.
- `POST /segment/v2/mc-ecs-event-emitter/t` — Send segment event data.
- `POST /v1/rum/web` — Send RUM (Real User Monitoring) data.

### Config (3)
- `GET /accounts/{accountHash}/config/V3/live/mailchimp.com/be_schema_info.json` — Read Mailchimp account configuration.
- `GET /accounts/{accountHash}/config/V3/live/mailchimp.com/integrations/{integrationId}/be_schema_info.json` — Get schema information for a Mailchimp integration.
- `GET /accounts/{accountHash}/config/V3/live/mailchimp.com/integrations/be_schema_info.json` — Read Mailchimp integration configuration.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Mailchimp's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Mailchimp data without official API access
- Automate actions on mailchimp.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Mailchimp frontend uses

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { MailchimpClient } from "./scripts/api.ts";

// Load captured auth from auth.json
const client = await MailchimpClient.fromAuthFile("auth.json");

// Make requests to internal endpoints
const result = await client.get("/endpoint");
```

## Captured Authentication

The `auth.json` file contains credentials extracted from browser traffic:
- **Auth headers:** 4 (sec-fetch-storage-access, authorization, x-goog-api-key, x-youtube-ad-signals)
- **Session cookies:** 21

If auth expires, re-run `unbrowse_login` or `unbrowse_capture` to refresh tokens.
